```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
source("R/prepare_data.R")

set.seed(42)
nba <- load_shot_data(sample_per_group = 1200L)
explorer <- nba$sampled_shots |>
  filter(
    !is.na(loc_x),
    !is.na(loc_y),
    abs(loc_x) <= 25,
    loc_y >= 0,
    loc_y <= 47,
    basic_zone != "Backcourt"
  )

dir.create("docs/data", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(explorer, "docs/data/shot_explorer_sample.csv")
```

Filter by season, team, shot type, and result.

::: {.callout-note}
## Injury Note For Interpretation
Stephen Curry broke his left hand on **October 30, 2019** (season **2019-20**), underwent surgery, and missed **58 consecutive games**.  
He played only **5 games** that season, briefly returned in March 2020, and Golden State finished **15-50**.  
Use the season filter to inspect the injury season directly while comparing shot behavior around it.
:::

```{ojs}
shotData = await d3.csv("data/shot_explorer_sample.csv", d3.autoType)

typeaheadInput = (options, {label, value, placeholder, maxSuggestions = 5}) => {
  const listId = `suggest-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`
  const wrapper = html`<label style="display:grid; gap:0.35rem;">
    <span>${label} (search)</span>
    <input type="text" list="${listId}" value="${value ?? ""}" placeholder="${placeholder ?? ""}" style="width:100%;">
    <datalist id="${listId}"></datalist>
    <small style="opacity:0.75;">Top ${maxSuggestions} suggestions while typing</small>
  </label>`
  const input = wrapper.querySelector("input")
  const datalist = wrapper.querySelector("datalist")
  const optionStrings = options.map(option => String(option))

  const refreshSuggestions = () => {
    const query = input.value.trim().toLowerCase()
    const matches = optionStrings
      .filter(option => option.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      .slice(0, maxSuggestions)
    datalist.replaceChildren(...matches.map(match => html`<option value="${match}"></option>`))
  }

  const emitInput = () => {
    wrapper.value = input.value
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    refreshSuggestions()
    emitInput()
  })
  input.addEventListener("change", emitInput)

  wrapper.value = input.value
  refreshSuggestions()
  return wrapper
}

adaptiveInput = (options, config) => (
  options.length > 10
    ? typeaheadInput(options, config)
    : Inputs.select(options, {label: config.label, value: config.value})
)

resolveSearchValue = (inputValue, options, fallback) => {
  if (options.length === 0) return fallback ?? null
  const fallbackValue = options.includes(fallback) ? fallback : options[0]
  const query = String(inputValue ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!query) return fallbackValue
  const exact = options.find(option => String(option).toLowerCase() === query)
  if (exact) return exact
  const partial = options.find(option => String(option).toLowerCase().includes(query))
  return partial ?? fallbackValue
}

seasonMeta = Array.from(
  new Set(shotData.map(d => +d.season))
).sort((a, b) => a - b).map(season => ({
  season,
  season_label: `${season}-${String((season + 1) % 100).padStart(2, "0")}`
}))

seasonLookup = new Map(seasonMeta.map(d => [d.season, d.season_label]))
seasonFromLabel = new Map(seasonMeta.map(d => [d.season_label, d.season]))
seasonLabels = seasonMeta.map(d => d.season_label)
seasonOptions = ["All seasons", ...seasonLabels]
injurySeason = 2019
injuryLabel = seasonLookup.get(injurySeason) ?? "2019-20"
injuryNote = `Injury context: broken left hand (${injuryLabel}), 58-game absence, 5 games played, Warriors 15-50.`

teamOptions = ["All teams", ...Array.from(new Set(
  shotData.map(d => d.team_name).filter(Boolean)
)).sort((a, b) => d3.ascending(a, b))]

defaultSeason = seasonLabels[seasonLabels.length - 1]

viewof seasonFilterInput = adaptiveInput(seasonOptions, {
  label: "Season",
  value: defaultSeason,
  placeholder: "Type season, e.g. 2019-20"
})

viewof teamFilterInput = adaptiveInput(teamOptions, {
  label: "Team",
  value: "All teams",
  placeholder: "Type team name..."
})

viewof shotTypeFilter = Inputs.radio(["All", "2PT", "3PT"], {
  label: "Shot Type",
  value: "All"
})

viewof resultFilter = Inputs.radio(["All", "Made", "Missed"], {
  label: "Result",
  value: "All"
})

seasonFilter = resolveSearchValue(seasonFilterInput, seasonOptions, defaultSeason)
teamFilter = resolveSearchValue(teamFilterInput, teamOptions, "All teams")
selectedSeason = seasonFilter === "All seasons" ? null : seasonFromLabel.get(seasonFilter)

filteredShots = shotData.filter(d =>
  (selectedSeason === null || d.season === selectedSeason) &&
  (teamFilter === "All teams" || d.team_name === teamFilter) &&
  (shotTypeFilter === "All" || d.shot_type === shotTypeFilter) &&
  (resultFilter === "All" || d.shot_made === resultFilter)
)

md`Showing **${filteredShots.length.toLocaleString()}** sampled shots.  
${injuryNote}`
```

```{ojs}
arcPoints = (cx, cy, r, startDeg, endDeg, steps = 80) => {
  const pts = []
  const start = startDeg * Math.PI / 180
  const end = endDeg * Math.PI / 180
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const t = start + (end - start) * (i / steps)
    pts.push({x: cx + r * Math.cos(t), y: cy + r * Math.sin(t)})
  }
  return pts
}

courtSegments = () => {
  const segs = []
  const pushLine = (a, b, id) => segs.push({id, points: [{x: a[0], y: a[1]}, {x: b[0], y: b[1]}]})

  pushLine([-25, 0], [25, 0], "baseline")
  pushLine([-25, 0], [-25, 47], "left_sideline")
  pushLine([25, 0], [25, 47], "right_sideline")
  pushLine([-25, 47], [25, 47], "halfcourt")

  pushLine([-8, 0], [-8, 19], "paint_left")
  pushLine([8, 0], [8, 19], "paint_right")
  pushLine([-8, 19], [8, 19], "paint_top")

  segs.push({id: "restricted", points: arcPoints(0, 5.25, 4, 0, 180, 70)})
  segs.push({id: "freethrow", points: arcPoints(0, 19, 6, 0, 360, 120)})
  pushLine([-22, 0], [-22, 14], "corner3_left")
  pushLine([22, 0], [22, 14], "corner3_right")
  segs.push({id: "arc3", points: arcPoints(0, 5.25, 23.75, 22, 158, 120)})

  return segs
}

segmentRows = courtSegments().flatMap(seg =>
  seg.points.map((p, i) => ({id: seg.id, order: i, x: p.x, y: p.y}))
)
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 930,
  height: 520,
  subtitle: injuryNote,
  margin: 18,
  x: {domain: [-25, 25], axis: null},
  y: {domain: [0, 47], axis: null},
  color: {
    legend: true,
    domain: ["Made", "Missed"],
    range: ["#2e7d32", "#c62828"]
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.line(segmentRows, {x: "x", y: "y", z: "id", stroke: "#8b8f93", strokeWidth: 1.1}),
    Plot.dot(filteredShots, {
      x: "loc_x",
      y: "loc_y",
      fill: "shot_made",
      r: 1.5,
      opacity: 0.45,
      tip: true
    })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 930,
  height: 520,
  subtitle: injuryNote,
  margin: 18,
  x: {domain: [-25, 25], axis: null},
  y: {domain: [0, 47], axis: null},
  color: {scheme: "YlOrRd", legend: true, label: "Shot density"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(filteredShots, Plot.bin({fill: "count"}, {x: "loc_x", y: "loc_y"})),
    Plot.line(segmentRows, {x: "x", y: "y", z: "id", stroke: "#8b8f93", strokeWidth: 1})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
zoneAgg = d3.rollups(
  filteredShots,
  v => v.length,
  d => d.basic_zone
).map(([zone, count]) => ({zone, count})).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)

Plot.plot({
  width: 930,
  height: 350,
  subtitle: injuryNote,
  marginLeft: 170,
  x: {label: "Shot count"},
  y: {label: null},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(zoneAgg, {x: "count", y: "zone", fill: "#1f4e79"}),
    Plot.text(zoneAgg, {
      x: "count",
      y: "zone",
      text: d => d.count.toLocaleString(),
      textAnchor: "start",
      dx: 6,
      fill: "#333"
    })
  ]
})
```
